bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
before=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial)
echo PARTIAL_BEFORE_BYTES="$before"
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py download_channel_video_step --channel-id 1877875443 --message-id 800 --json
if test -f /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial;then
after=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial)
else
after=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.mp4)
fi
echo FILE_AFTER_BYTES="$after"
test "$after" -gt "$before"
echo REAL_VIDEO_BYTE_PROGRESS=PASS
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
